title: What I Shared with Methodist Clergy
excerpt: I’ve had the pleasure and honor of sharing with Methodist clergy this week in California. Here are the slides from my talks – on heart health for clergy, on heart health for denominations, and heart health for congregations. cal pac umc 2017
